required_gates.requirement: All automated gates pass on the exact current tested commit; extracted artifacts and real CLI scenarios are verified.
Actual Linux Wi-Fi AP activation, interruption and restoration with representative adapter/driver; mock tests are insufficient.
Actual mount removal/replacement/reinsertion during scan, no wrong-device resume, and recovery/service behavior on representative hardware.

Pinned equivalent whole-program scan/read/transfer workloads on controlled identical hardware; CPU/GiB, sustained throughput, true peak RSS and shutdown distributions. Packet-only shared CI samples are insufficient.
Operator-provisioned trusted signing key, actual signed release origin/artifacts, staged activation and rollback in the deployment environment.

evidence_delivery: Pass the independently reviewed external evidence manifest to scripts/check_parity.py --require-complete --evidence FILE. A manifest-only pass is insufficient; every gate report is re-read and digest/bindings/gate semantics are verified, and every reviewer attestation is re-fetched from the GitHub PR review API. GITHUB_TOKEN is optional for public repositories but recommended to avoid anonymous API rate limits.

evidence_contract.reviewer_rule: reviewed_by must match the live GitHub PR review actor and differ case-insensitively from both report.performed_actor and report.performed_by; the live review must be APPROVED on the exact tested commit, belong to evidence_contract.review_scope, and its JSON body attestation must bind gate ID, report SHA-256, tested commit and approve decision
evidence_contract.report_rule: report must be a regular file opened without following symlinks; its SHA-256, gate_id, tested_commit, pass result and gate-specific semantic requirements must verify

current-ci: x86_64 and aarch64 artifacts bind workflow head and BUILD-INFO to tested commit
packaged python-rust-comparison rust_sha binds the same tested commit
GitHub ZIP, outer tar archive and packaged binary SHA-256 digests are recorded
outer checksum, inner SHA256SUMS and packaged self-test verified
physical-hotspot: real non-virtual Wi-Fi hardware identity, interface and driver
previous connection restored when one existed
physical-hotplug: real removable/hotplug original and replacement device identities
unmount during active scan and original reinsertion exercised
replacement mounted at the same path
old checkpoint rejected for replacement device
resume scope changed and service recovered
controlled-cutover: workflow artifact, BUILD-INFO and packaged comparison bind exact tested commit
artifact architecture/ID/name, GitHub ZIP SHA-256, outer tar SHA-256 and binary SHA-256 exactly match one current-ci artifact
metadata/read/transfer and shutdown raw samples for Python and Rust
production-release-trust: non-synthetic production signing identity and fingerprint
actual production release origin and artifact digest/provenance
staging, activation, health verification, rollback and post-rollback health verified

evidence_contract.review_reference_rule: review_reference must exactly target the configured evidence_contract.review_scope repository and pull request using https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pr}/reviews/{id}. Full-replacement verification re-fetches that review, verifies numeric ID/state/commit/reviewer, requires the returned pull_request_url to match the configured scope, and checks review_body_sha256 so foreign-repository, foreign-PR, edited, dismissed or stale reviews fail closed.
